description: Alternative examined after the frozen A/B. Isolated parser accepts the actual first signed image-corpus input from scripts/benchmark_image_batch.py (145494 payload bytes) or one 11-byte greeting inside a 361-byte frame. Compares serde_json Value then typed conversion against borrowed raw parameter and typed conversion. Six balanced pairs per size. No Wasmtime, IPC or worker. Prospective recommendation threshold >=25% less image parse time and <=10 microseconds greeting penalty. Shared engineering host, no quiet host claim. Neither the frozen daemon nor the follow-on patch contains this alternative.
